title: Legends of Tenochtitlan
summary: Old stories of the gods who led the Aztecs.

claims.text: The Aztecs came from Aztlan, a city in a lake far to the northwest; the mage Quetzalcoatl, the Feathered Serpent, is said to have led them in peace for ages before leaving with a promise to return.
The tale goes on that Huitzilopoctli walked out of the sea and claimed the Aztecs and demanded their worship.

title: The Mexico City earthquake of 1985
summary: A disaster that set the city's supernatural factions against one another.

claims.text: The quake of 19 September 1985 damaged over 4,000 buildings and killed more than 9,000 people.
Garou, Kindred and mages have blamed each other, Pentex and demons, but no supernatural cause has been found, and tension between the ruling factions has grown ever since.

title: Pentex in Mexico City
summary: The Wyrm's corporation among the city's rich and poor.

claims.text: Senior Pentex executives in Mexico City are paid lavishly and live like royalty.
Factory workers earn a pittance for twelve-hour days, are picked for desperation and low morals, and are exposed every day to subliminal corruption.

title: The Inquisition in Mexico City
summary: Witch-hunters based at the city's great cathedral.

claims.text: About a dozen witch-hunters work from the Latin Cross Cathedral; the mortal Inquisitors all hold strong True Faith, which has kept them alive.
Records on the Kindred and Awakened of North America are said to lie buried beneath the Sagrario beside the cathedral, sinking slowly into the old lake bed.
